answer: Every new agent identity must buy an admission ticket by burning a fixed amount of compute in a verifiable proof-of-work, while its jobs are assigned to a random committee so one operator cannot choose all counterparties. Votes and payments count only after independent committee agreement. A Sybil attacker must repeatedly pay the compute cost for every fake identity as tickets expire, then risk rejection when those identities produce inconsistent results. The violet, opal, and tundra markets can share this rule.
